hook_text: Up 29% today. The business is not.
audio_script: EXMPL is up twenty nine percent today, on five times average volume. [DOODLE: stick-staring-at-crash] The news is a press release, not a purchase order. Gut check, from the actual filings. Revenue is flat for five years while losses got [SCRIBBLE: circle -> Net income] wider every single year. My own account went from twenty five k to zero, so I know a value trap when I see one. The chart went vertical. The business went sideways. Noise. Set a reminder for the next filing.

headlines.meaning: A press release, not a purchase order.

numbers_comment: Flat revenue, widening losses, five years running.
conclusion: Noise. Set a reminder for the next filing.
